blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The August Twenty-One Movement (Atom) on Wednesday denounced President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for his trip to Singapore, where he is expected to attend the Formula 1 Grand Prix, as Filipinos grapple with rising fuel and electricity prices. In a statement, the group described Marcos as an “apathetic, indifferent, carefree” leader and questioned his decision to make another trip to Singapore to attend a luxury event it said was associated with heavy fuel consumption amid a global energy crisis. The group said Marcos’ work schedule coinciding with the Singapore F1 event was not the first such instance during his presidency. […]...
